allow: PowerShell(try { Get-WinEvent -LogName "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall" -MaxEvents 40 -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Id -in 2004,2005,2006,2033 } | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, @{n='Event';e={switch\($_.Id\){2004{'rule ADDED'}2005{'rule MODIFIED'}2006{'rule DELETED'}2033{'all rules deleted'}}}}, @{n='Rule';e={\($_.Message -split "`n" | Select-String 'Rule Name|Name:' | Select-Object -First 1\).ToString\(\).Trim\(\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap } catch { Write-Output "Could not read that log: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $ev = Get-WinEvent -LogName "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall" -MaxEvents 25 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "events found: $\($ev.Count\)"; $ev | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, LevelDisplayName | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { Write-Output "LOG UNAVAILABLE: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($all = Get-WinEvent -LogName "Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "total events in log: $\($all.Count\)"; Write-Output "oldest: $\(\($all | Select-Object -Last 1\).TimeCreated\)"; Write-Output "--- event id counts ---"; $all | Group-Object Id | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object Name, Count | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "--- events during my test window \(09:15-09:30 on 01/10\) ---"; $all | Where-Object { $_.TimeCreated -ge \(Get-Date "01/10/2026 09:15"\) -and $_.TimeCreated -le \(Get-Date "01/10/2026 09:35"\) } | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, @{n='Msg';e={\($_.Message -replace "`r`n"," | "\).Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(160,$_.Message.Length\)\)}} | Format-List)
